## ST-SSL 

> Use this as a benchmark for everything else. We want to 
figure out what were the other top models to evaluate. 
This paper is very recent, and it comes out of a top 
conference (AAAI). Notes for this section based on ST-SSL by 
Ji et al. @ji2023etal. The GitHub repository for this model 
is available [here](https://github.com/Echo-Ji/ST-SSL)

This work is the current state of the art in traffic flow forecasting 
and prediction tasks. They evaluate their models on the NYBike1 and
other more challenging datasets, instead of the Pems datasets as 
was the case with most prior works.
